title: Absolute value inequality for the noise operator
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Then $|T_\rho f(x)|\leq T_\rho(|f|)(x)$, where $T_\rho$ is the operator that multiplies each Walsh coefficient indexed by a set $S$ by $\rho^{|S|}$.
